record.paper_title: Open Problems on Eigenvalues of the Laplacian
record.original_question: Let Ω vary over bounded domains in ℝⁿ, and let λ₁ ≤ λ₂ ≤ ··· be its Dirichlet Laplacian eigenvalues. For every pair of integers k, m ≥ 1, must one always have λ_{km}/λₘ ≤ sup_D λ_k(D)/λ₁(D), where the supremum is taken over bounded domains D?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a bounded domain $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^n$, let $0 < \lambda_1(\Omega) \le \lambda_2(\Omega) \le \lambda_3(\Omega) \le \cdots$ denote the eigenvalues (counted with multiplicity) of the Dirichlet Laplacian on $\Omega$, i.e. the values $\lambda$ for which there exists a nonzero $u \in H_0^1(\Omega)$ with $-\Delta u = \lambda u$ in $\Omega$ and $u = 0$ on $\partial \Omega$.

For each integer $k \ge 1$, define
$$ R_k := \sup_{D} \frac{\lambda_k(D)}{\lambda_1(D)}, $$
where the supremum is taken over all bounded domains $D \subset \mathbb{R}^n$.

Prove or disprove: for every pair of integers $k, m \ge 1$ and every bounded domain $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^n$,
$$ \frac{\lambda_{km}(\Omega)}{\lambda_m(\Omega)} \;\le\; R_k. $$
artifact.status_search_result: The question is part of a well-known circle of conjectures about universal bounds for ratios of Dirichlet Laplacian eigenvalues, going back to Payne–Pólya–Weinberger and Ashbaugh–Benguria. The base case k=2, m=1 is the PPW conjecture, proved by Ashbaugh–Benguria; the more general inequality λ_{km}/λ_m ≤ sup λ_k/λ_1 remains open, with only partial results known for small k and m.

status_evidence.title: On Ashbaugh-Benguria's Conjecture about Lower Order Dirichlet Eigenvalues of the Laplacian
status_evidence.snippet: strengthens the well-known Ashbaugh-Benguria inequality on the ratio of the first two Dirichlet eigenvalues and addresses related open conjectures on higher-order ratios.
status_evidence.claim: Conjectures of Ashbaugh–Benguria type on higher-order Dirichlet eigenvalue ratios are still being investigated, with only partial progress.

status_evidence.title: More Bounds on Eigenvalue Ratios for Dirichlet Laplacians in N Dimensions
status_evidence.snippet: Bounds for various combinations of low eigenvalues of the Dirichlet Laplacian, generalizing PPW-type ratio bounds.
status_evidence.claim: Universal ratio bounds beyond λ_2/λ_1 are only partially known.
